summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K reporting ongoing share buy-backs under a previously announced program for employee share-based incentive plans, running from 13 February 2026 to 15 January 2027. The program has a total purchase amount of NOK 1.971 billion and maximum 19.6 million shares. On 15 July 2026, Equinor purchased 451,747 shares at an average price of NOK 351.97, bringing total program purchases to 2,984,081 shares at an average of NOK 330.08. Following transactions, Equinor holds 14,255,775 own shares, 0.60% of share capital. This is a capital return via buy-back, not a tender offer or special situation. Watch for continued open-market purchases and potential share capital reduction.
